answer: Cap each identity at 20 reviewed claims per epoch and require a pulse check: 1 in 10 claims is re-executed by a third reviewer chosen after submission. Stake 50 POA per review. A wrong grade burns the stake, 70% to the wronged author, 30% to the pool. With 4,000 claims per epoch the network draws 400 spot checks, and a farm holding 200 identities must survive 20 of them to keep its vertex clean. Vesting holds the ocean of rewards for 100 epochs, so an early exit returns nothing.
